title: Dream World House
content: There’s a house I visit in my dreams that never changes. I always have trouble remembering it when I wake up but the most distinctive thing is the nursery in the attic. It’s one room. There’s a cradle. It’s small. Other key rooms is the gymnasium located in the middle of the house,(It’s a HUGE house), the long hallways with funky wallpaper, and another long hallway with huge, almost industrial-like doors that ALMOST go on forever, each door leading to a different room, until you reach a dark room at the end filled with nightmarish things. The architecture of the house makes no sense at all, and the only time I remember seeing it from the outside it was dark. It’s hard to describe it, but the house almost looks stacked on top of eachother??? And much more worn out than it does on the outside. It’s wide and gets smaller as you get to the top. You can see where the nursery is because the peak of the house is so small. It’s so hard to describe what I mean because it defies physics but I see it so clearly in my head. Does this sound familiar at all to anyone?
